fields.Position Description: Assist with daily care of a research colony, including preparing feed and performing health checks. Use tracking software to monitor and record data. Prepare laboratory buffer solutions. Work independently, demonstrate initiative, and communicate clearly with the team.
fields.Qualifications: Hard-working students interested in animal health or lab operations. Previous wet-lab or animal-care experience is an asset.
fields.Department / Unit Overview: A biomedical research facility. Work-study students interact with undergraduate, graduate, and postdoctoral researchers.
fields.Skills: Communication Organization and Records Management Professionalism Teamwork
